name: Victoria Falls & Hwange
about: Dry season (May–Oct) concentrates wildlife around Hwange's waterholes and is prime game-viewing season; the Falls themselves are most powerful just after the rains (Mar–May), though that's not peak safari season.
overview: Victoria Falls' Zimbabwe side — considered the better view, bungee jumping and rafting below the gorge — paired with Hwange's elephants.
costOverview: Everyday food is cheap — the Falls entry and adrenaline activities, bungee jumping and whitewater rafting, are real one-time costs, and Hwange's luxury safari lodges anchor the top of the range.

specialSeasons.text: The Falls are at their most powerful and dramatic just after the rains — though this isn't peak game-viewing season, and heavy spray can obscure the view from some vantage points.
